name: @releaseready/playwright-framework
description: Reviewed Cucumber + Playwright execution adapters, runtime login and input preparation for ReleaseReady

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.cucumber.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/readiness/tsconfig.json && tsc -p starter/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:guardrails
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run check:review-pins && npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:cucumber && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/cucumber/scripts/data-references.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/reference-only-preparation.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/runtime-login-ordering.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/shared-helpers.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/runtime-login-cleanup.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/windows-taskkill.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/teardown-evidence.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/guarded-route.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/paused-work-clock.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/feature-validation.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/agentic-rehearsal.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/reuse-readiness.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/private-starter.test.js && cucumber-js --profile input-preparation && cucumber-js --profile reporting && npm run test:typescript-source-policy
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:cucumber && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/cucumber/scripts/runtime-login.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/partay-login.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/execution-adapter.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/reporting.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/adapter-contract.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/cucumber-timeouts.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/login-inspection.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/login-inspection-cancellation.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/authentication-only.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/owned-local-adapter.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/runtime-login-entry.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/runtime-login-package.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/isolated-product-playwright.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/runtime-login-cancellation-browser.test.js && cucumber-js --config cucumber.json && cucumber-js --profile adapter && cucumber-js --profile retry-regression && npm run test:readiness
scripts.test:input-preparation: npm run build:cucumber && cucumber-js --profile input-preparation && node --test dist/cucumber/scripts/data-references.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/runtime-login.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/reference-only-preparation.test.js
scripts.test:execution: npm run build:cucumber && node --test dist/cucumber/scripts/windows-taskkill.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/execution-adapter.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/teardown-evidence.test.js dist/cucumber/scripts/guarded-route.test.js && cucumber-js --profile retry-regression
scripts.test:reporting: npm run build:cucumber && node --test dist/cucumber/scripts/reporting.test.js && cucumber-js --profile reporting
scripts.test:adapter: npm run build:cucumber && node --test dist/cucumber/scripts/adapter-contract.test.js && cucumber-js --profile adapter
scripts.test:features:regression: npm run test:input-preparation && npm run test:customer-login && npm run test:validation && npm run test:features && npm run test:execution && node --test dist/cucumber/scripts/cucumber-timeouts.test.js && npm run test:reporting && npm run test:adapter

author: Universal Testing Framework Contributors
